head_start.description: Qwen3.5-0.8B, non-thinking, full-weight GRPO on GSM8K for 100 steps. A = base, B = base + Opus agent's anti-hedging edit (4,089 weights), C = same-size random edit. Quick evals at steps 0/15/30/50/100: GSM-Symbolic sampled at T=1 (symT1_acc, primary), greedy (sym_acc), IFEval prompt-level strict (200 prompts). Values in %.

b_minus_a_mean_over_seeds.derived: mean over seeds 0,1 of (B - A) at each eval step, points

train_per_step.note: training-batch accuracy/truncation (%) and mean length per GRPO step

head_start.note: Arm D (T=0.8 sampling) was invalid (temperature bug) and is omitted.

thinking_loop.description: Sparks counterfactual: base Qwen3.5-0.8B in thinking mode (4,096-token limit), 30 steps of GRPO, seed 0, no edit arm. Held-out: first 128 GSM8K test problems with Sparks' sampling.
